rules.scientific_truth: Every datum, object, relation and uncertainty must be source-grounded; conceptual elements must be labelled. No invented causal edge or result.
rules.safe_output: Use the selected backend contract; no scripts, external SVG references, arbitrary execution or admission bypass.
rules.physical_readability: Assess fonts and strokes at the declared physical size; pixels and a valid SVG do not establish publication readability.
rules.caption_boundary: Figure titles and explanations belong outside the canvas; panel tags and short object labels are allowed.
rules.format_priority: Verified venue constraints and explicit author choices apply within scope; report conflicts, retain factual/safety rules and use one font/title policy.
rules.typed_relations: Differentiate control, data and support relations with explicit labels and evidence. Axes and APA statistics formatting are not universal schematic requirements.
rules.sourced_depth: Spatial depth is allowed when it expresses a sourced scientific object or mechanism; renderer support must be checked.
